title: Validation, debugging, and browser inspection
learningObjectives: Apply validation, debugging, and browser inspection accurately and accessibly.

understand.concept: Validate document structure, inspect console and network errors, test responsive behaviour and keyboard access. A validator cannot prove usability or security.
understand.whyItMatters: Correct HTML structure improves accessibility, privacy and maintainability.
understand.analogy: Think of a document where each part has a defined role.
understand.analogyLimit: Exact behaviour follows HTML semantics and browser rules.

explain.narrative: Validate document structure, inspect console and network errors, test responsive behaviour and keyboard access. A validator cannot prove usability or security.

examples.code: Inspect the network panel if the image fails.
examples.explanation: Inspect the attributes and browser behaviour.
examples.expectedOutput: The browser renders the HTML structure.

practise.guidedTask: Modify the example and test with keyboard and browser inspection.
practise.independentTask: Build an accessible page section and explain your element choices.
hints: Test all controls using a keyboard.
A validator does not guarantee usability or security.

practice.starterCode: Inspect the network panel if the image fails.
practice.resetCode: Inspect the network panel if the image fails.

questions.prompt: Can an HTML validator prove a site is secure?
questions.explanation: Consider semantic purpose, accessibility and security.

questions.prompt: Can one validation tool fully certify accessibility and security?
questions.explanation: Separate manual and automated checks are required.
